review_sampling: Every 75 frames starting at frame 37, fixed before new inference
test: Sampled frames 1500 and above, reserved for scoring after parameter selection
labels: Assistant raw-frame review without model overlays. Visible centers are approximate; ambiguous visibility is unknown, not a negative.
limitations: Same reused recording; temporally separated development/test samples are not a fresh independent game or human ground truth. Cross-game existing annotations remain regression tests. No claim that output coverage is accuracy.
